scope: Two bounded host-only SDL/D3D12 interop runs; hidden SDL window

runner.utf8:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
lab=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;repo=lab.parent/'try-omarchy-windows'
number=sys.argv[1];mode=sys.argv[2]
assert number.isdigit() and mode in ('caps','full')
out=lab/f'sdl-interop-run-{number}';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
build=lab/'sdl-interop-native-v7'
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
receipt=read(build/'receipt.json')
source=repo/'experimental/windows-native-gpu/sdl-interop/sdl_d3d12_interop.cpp'
recipe=source.with_name('build.ps1');binary=build/'sdl-d3d12-interop.exe'
assert sha(source)==receipt['sourceSha256'] and sha(recipe)==receipt['buildScriptSha256']
assert sha(source.with_name('gl_external_api.h'))==receipt['bindingHeaderSha256']
assert sha(binary)==receipt['binarySha256']
qemu=lab/'qemu-desktop-slots1024';qemu_receipt=read(lab/'qemu-desktop-slots1024-receipt.json')
sdl=qemu/'bin/SDL2.dll'
assert sha(sdl)==qemu_receipt['files']['bin/SDL2.dll']
command=[str(binary),str(sdl),str(out/'gpu-buffers')]+(['--capabilities-only'] if mode=='caps' else [])
value=dict(schema=1,mode=mode,buildReceipt=receipt,sdlLibrarySha256=sha(sdl),
    qemuArtifactRevision=qemu_receipt['revision'],command=command,
    runnerSha256=sha(Path(__file__)),qemuFrontendVerified=False,guestFrameVerified=False)
with (out/'source.json').open('x') as file:json.dump(value,file,indent=2)
with (out/'native.log').open('x') as log:
    try:
        result=subprocess.run(command,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=45,creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
        value['exitCode']=result.returncode;value['timedOut']=False
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        value['exitCode']=None;value['timedOut']=True
value['sourcesUnchanged']=sha(source)==receipt['sourceSha256'] and sha(recipe)==receipt['buildScriptSha256'] and sha(source.with_name('gl_external_api.h'))==receipt['bindingHeaderSha256']
assert value['sourcesUnchanged']
(out/'source.json').write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print((out/'native.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8'),end='')
print('OWNED_SDL_INTEROP_EXIT',value['exitCode'],'TIMEOUT',value['timedOut'])
sys.exit(1 if value['timedOut'] or value['exitCode'] else 0)
